latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Adds support for managing Obsidian vaults as a knowledge base.

- Fuzzy/phonetic search across all notes using fast ripgrep filtering.
- Automatic folder detection for new notes and note suggestion based on content.
- Create, read, and edit notes with frontmatter (timestamps, tags, aliases).
- Manage tags, incoming/outgoing wikilinks, and sections within notes.
- Comprehensive CLI scripts for querying, saving, editing, and organizing notes and folders.
- Designed workflows for knowledge base queries, note creation, and prompt-driven editing.
